name: deepseek-fix-upper
note: Upstream b647d1879 (Go: openai_compat.go isDeepSeek hoist + ToLower): custom model whose baseUrl carries UPPERCASE 'API.DeepSeek.COM', hitting the now case-folded baseUrl route into isDeepSeek — mirrors the upstream test's customUppercaseModel case. Three independent observables ride on it: max_tokens (not max_completion_tokens) = useMaxTokens; the thinking key = thinkingFormat 'deepseek'; the ABSENCE of store:false = isNonStandard, which is precisely the hoist's effect. A systemPrompt is included so the system-vs-developer role pins supportsDeveloperRole too (it is unobservable without one). Pin 536eb7179 contains the fix sha, so the default PI_UPSTREAM_SHA reference carries it. Sibling of deepseek-fix-custom, which pins the lowercase route. Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.2; backend flipped to dist (README rule).
